result.title: Coding And Gyming
result.description:
I handed three Devins my backlog at the same time and then went to the gym.

Gym, had ramen, came back to three PRs. One per ticket, each with its own summary of what changed.

I just got through three tickets in the time it normally takes me to write one 🫠

Link to try Devin is pinned in the comments 👇

result.title: AI Lifebot
result.description:
I don't take productivity advice from the internet anymore. I take it from LifeBot.

It's my personal productivity and health coach, built on Hermes. The difference is it runs on my own data: my sleep, my focus hours, my steps, not generic tips written for a brain I don't have.

So instead of "wake up at 5am," I get things like: you've been at this four hours, your focus dropped forty minutes ago, stop.

It's the only tool I've ever used that tells me to do less.

result.title: 3am Coding
result.description:
It's 3am. I have tickets still open, and the deadline is tomorrow morning, my brain is fully offline.

So I gave one to Devin, told it what I wanted, and went to bed. #sponsored

woke up to a PR.

still reviewed it properly myself. just didn't have to sit there babysitting every step at 3am 🫠

If you've got a backlog you keep avoiding, link's in the comments.
